plain_english_policy: Transfer more existing Medicaid recipients into managed care programs.

effects.rationale: Managed care programs often have restrictions on the types of services that can be provided and may require patients to choose from a limited set of providers.

evidence_quote: "Transfer more existing Medicaid recipients into managed care programs." - 2002 Health Issues Questionnaire Option b.
review_reason: The policy is described as a transfer to managed care programs which may have restrictions on services and provider choices.
